dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, scalloped perimeters on prominent light-colored rings; high-contrast gradient from bright off-white exterior boundaries to dark grey/black interior cores; multiple closed 'O' and semi-closed 'C' geometries visible on the lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, non-gradient high-intensity light spots clustered primarily in the anterior cervical region and interspersed between larger annular structures on the mid-body.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary trapezoidal formation is visible connecting the centroids of four large annuli on the upper lateral flank, with secondary triangular clusters formed by smaller satellites near the dorsal midline.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a fused 'double-annulus' or figure-eight structure located near the highest point of the dorsal curve.
